display_name: 智能小车基础硬件输入包（清洗版）
purpose: Generic layout/structure-synthesis agent input. Contains no previous vehicle placement, chassis, shell, or workflow rules.

subassemblies.relationship: fixed mechanical mating through double-D output interface; solver places the assembled module or enforces the interface as a hard constraint

global_requirements: all hardware poses are solved from the current appearance geometry; no historical pose may be used
external-access features are generated from hardware feature frames after pose selection
every embedded component requires a collision-free assembly/removal path unless explicitly non-serviceable
known_gaps: No independent authoritative charging-port definition is supplied. Do not invent one.
No authoritative standalone LA024 motor CAD is supplied; completed LA024+LA016 reference is used for packaging.
No authoritative drive/passive wheel CAD is supplied; only a 37 mm × 13 mm collision proxy generated from supplied dimensions is included.
Component masses and centers of mass are not supplied.
Controller connector semantic frames are not supplied and need annotation before port-access optimization.

source.published_hardware_binding: cyberbrick-zk004-manual release 1.0.4 as stated in supplied provenance
